content.text:
I wrote "Answer: informal is more common before 2023-02-22" to `/work/answer.txt`. This is an estimate, not an exact count.

The data has no labels, so I had to judge formal versus informal myself. I used a rough rule-based check, not a hand count. A sentence counted as informal if it started lowercase, lacked ending punctuation, was all caps, or contained markers like "!!", "...", "thanks" or slang.

By that rule, about 34% of the 92 sentences before 2023-02-22 were informal. About 23% of the 204 sentences after that date were informal. The gap is large enough that I expect the direction to hold. The rule is crude, though, so I can't rule out a different result from an exact manual labelling.
